subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should the malformed workspace-skill diagnostic fix be accepted as a scoped `skills lint` command first, or must it also expose failed-load reasons through normal `skills list`/`skills check`/status/Web surfaces before this issue is considered solved?
rationale: Current source proves the diagnostic gap and an open PR owns a plausible CLI implementation, but the requested surface spans CLI validation, status, and Web console behavior, which is a product/API scope decision.

options.title: Land scoped CLI lint first
options.body: Accept `skills lint` as the first core diagnostic surface, with docs and focused tests, and track normal status/Web visibility separately if maintainers want it.

options.title: Require full status visibility
options.body: Hold the fix until failed-load reasons are available through the normal skills status/list/check/Web path as well as any lint command.

options.title: Defer the new command
options.body: Keep this issue as backlog and close or pause the active PR if maintainers do not want a new public skills validation surface now.

recommendation.title: Land scoped CLI lint first
recommendation.body: Accept `skills lint` as the first core diagnostic surface, with docs and focused tests, and track normal status/Web visibility separately if maintainers want it.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about CLI/status product scope, and this owner has the strongest history across the skills CLI and parser/status-adjacent surfaces.
